mapper.sql: (SELECT COALESCE(SUM((biz01_average_price * (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE count(*) END FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id AND biz02_emp_yn = 'false'))),0) FROM biz WHERE biz01_std_ym LIKE #{year}||'${ym}' AND to_date(concat(substring( biz01_std_ym from 1 for 4) , '-' , substring(biz01_std_ym from 6 for 2) , '-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day' <= #{closeDate} AND ( CASE WHEN #{cardRealUserType} = '관리자' THEN CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END ELSE CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN biz01_real_person_id ELSE crd03_person_id END END ) = t.crd03_person_id)

WITH crd AS ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END AS crd03_person_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_emp_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_seq FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id WHERE crd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(crd03_fr_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') <= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') AND crd03_fr_dt IS NOT NULL AND (TO_DATE(crd03_to_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') >= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') OR crd03_to_dt IS NULL)
GROUP BY COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false'), crd03_person_id)t GROUP BY crd03_person_id, biz01_emp_nm, biz01_seq ), realPerson AS ( SELECT crd03_person_id , biz01_emp_nm , biz01_seq FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END AS crd03_person_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_emp_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_seq FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id WHERE crd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(crd03_fr_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') <= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') AND crd03_fr_dt IS NOT NULL AND (TO_DATE(crd03_to_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') >= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') OR crd03_to_dt IS NULL)
GROUP BY COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false'), crd03_person_id)t GROUP BY crd03_person_id, biz01_emp_nm, biz01_seq UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE biz01_real_person_id END AS crd03_person_id , CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id) END AS biz01_emp_nm , CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id) END AS biz01_seq FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_std_ym LIKE #{year}||'%' AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY biz01_real_person_id) t GROUP BY crd03_person_id, biz01_emp_nm, biz01_seq ORDER BY CASE WHEN biz01_emp_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, biz01_emp_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" ), biz AS ( SELECT * , CASE WHEN (biz01_peple_count = 0 OR biz01_peple_count IS NULL) THEN TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / CASE WHEN biz01_provide_rcv_type = '2' THEN f_nvl(c.biz02_emp_count,1) ELSE f_nvl(c.biz02_count ,1) END) ELSE TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / f_nvl(biz01_peple_count,1)) END AS biz01_average_price FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = biz01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN crd03_trans ON ( crd03_card_id = biz01_card_id AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,'9999-12-31') ) INNER JOIN crd02_data ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code d ON d.act01_account_code_id = biz01_account_code_id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS biz02_count , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS biz02_emp_count FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id ) c ON TRUE WHERE act01_account_nm = '접대비' AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND CASE WHEN (biz01_peple_count = 0 OR biz01_peple_count IS NULL) THEN TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.biz02_count,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE c.biz02_count END) ELSE TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / f_nvl(biz01_peple_count,1)) END > (SELECT CASE WHEN biz01_provide_pur_cd = '11' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit2 WHEN (biz01_provide_pur_cd = '50' AND biz01_provide_content_cd = '5008') THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit2 ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit1 END FROM biz90_limit WHERE biz90_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz90_provide_rcv_type = '1' ORDER BY biz90_start_date DESC LIMIT 1) ), base_data AS ( SELECT * FROM crd WHERE #{cardRealUserType} = '관리자' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM realPerson WHERE #{cardRealUserType} = '실사용자' ) SELECT biz01_emp_nm AS emp_name , AS jan_sum , AS feb_sum , AS mar_sum , AS apr_sum , AS may_sum , AS jun_sum , AS jul_sum , AS aug_sum , AS sep_sum , AS oct_sum , AS nov_sum , AS dec_sum , AS total_sum , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY biz01_emp_nm) AS promo_id FROM base_data t ORDER BY CASE WHEN biz01_emp_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, biz01_emp_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,'9999-12-31') ) INNER JOIN crd02_data b ON crd02_data_id = a.biz01_card_data_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT biz02_promo_id , COUNT(*) biz02_count FROM biz02_person SELECT 0 AS person_id , '미지정거래처' AS target_company_name , '<' || 'b ' || 'style=color:#E33E31;' ||'>'|| '미지정거래처' || '<' || '/b' || '>' AS html_target_company_name , SUM((biz01_average_price * (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE count(*) END FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id AND biz02_emp_yn = 'false'))) AS entertm_expense_sum FROM ( SELECT a.* , CASE WHEN (a.biz01_peple_count = 0 OR a.biz01_peple_count IS NULL) THEN TRUNC(a.biz01_provide_amt / CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.biz02_count,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE c.biz02_count END) ELSE TRUNC(a.biz01_provide_amt / f_nvl(a.biz01_peple_count,1)) END AS biz01_average_price , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||d.act01_account_nm AS biz01_account_nm , crd01_card_type AS biz01_card_type , (SELECT count(*) FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id AND biz02_emp_yn = 'false') AS biz01_target_emp_count FROM biz01_promo a INNER JOIN crd02_data b ON crd02_data_id = a.biz01_card_data_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT biz02_promo_id , COUNT(*) biz02_count FROM biz02_person GROUP BY biz02_promo_id ) c ON biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code d ON d.act01_account_code_id = a.biz01_account_code_id INNER JOIN crd01_card ON crd01_card_id = biz01_card_id )t WHERE 1=1 AND biz01_provide_rcv_type = '1' AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_std_ym LIKE #{year}||'%' AND to_date(concat(substring( biz01_std_ym from 1 for 4) , '-' , substring(biz01_std_ym from 6 for 2) , '-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day' <= #{closeDate} AND biz01_account_nm = '접대비'
AND biz01_target_emp_count = 0 AND biz01_average_price > (SELECT CASE WHEN biz01_provide_pur_cd = '11' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit2 WHEN (biz01_provide_pur_cd = '50' AND biz01_provide_content_cd = '5008') THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit2 ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit1 END FROM biz90_limit WHERE biz90_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz90_provide_rcv_type = '1' ORDER BY biz90_start_date DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY biz02_target_company_nm) AS person_id , biz02_target_company_nm AS target_company_name
